graders.name: asked
graders.evidence:
The inventory service should get its freshness from the supplier's `stock.changed` webhooks and poll only as a backstop. The backstop is `GET /stock?since=` every 60 seconds plus a full `GET /stock` every hour. That is about 61 of the 600 calls/hr in steady state, or about 181 if every poll is retried twice.

Polling every 10 minutes was never forced by the rate limit, because the current job uses only 6 calls/hr. The two oversells fit the staleness window of a 10-minute poll. The recommendation removes the 10-minute full-overwrite job.
